plan.speed_groups: Train/Validation causal origin speed terciles, separately per dataset
plan.selection: Stable SHA256 event order, round-robin crosswalk/date; two SHA256-ranked eligible origins per event; no model metrics used
plan.insufficient: fewer than 20 events OR 5 recordings; completion additionally fewer than 5 positive OR 5 negative events
plan.evaluation: complete-case, horizon-specific; no IPCW or calibration fit

eligibility.remaining_events_not_inferred: Bounded budget, deterministic pre-inference sampling; not failures

privacy: Private per-origin outputs; aggregate website summary only
